rust_person_name.command: cd crates && cargo run --release -p sensored-core --example person_name_eval -- ../packages/sensored/eval/corpus.json
rust_person_name.note: The official bar is not meaningful: ~710 of the 944 person_name_lite labels are person_name_lite false positives adopted into the corpus (Plate No, Ghana Card, Medical Record Number, street names), so only copying them can pass it. true_names scores the 234 generated names (name-pos-* and mixed-* labels not crossing a line break).
